The Timekeeper’s Tower: A structure older than the world itself, this tower was constructed at the beginning of linear time, in an effort by Vaior to control the branching of time and alternate timelines. The tower is legendary for its ability to manipulate time and the forces of nature through the Timekeeper’s Throne.

  

LAYOUT:

- Entry Hall: The first floor is a gigantic empty room with walls carved with waves and images of water crashing across the entire space of the room. The floor is glass placed above white tile floors 
- Spiral Staircase: An outdoor floating staircase of glass steps at 30ft wide spiraling around the outside of the tower.
- Throne Room: 
	- ENEMIES: Kairos, Night Serpent
		- LOOT: Gold Piles totaling to 80,000, 4 Celestial Gold Ingots, In Kairos' pocket there is a small silver necklace, a locket with a picture of a little girl inside (on the back of the photo it says: Lisa, my daughter. If anyone ever reads this, I am probably dead, which I think was my actual goal all along. 30,000 years unable to die, unable to really live either. My mind is not what it was, I cannot think of anything but my revenge. I hope death brings me the penance I deserve. I am sorry I am broken, I am sorry I let you down, Lisa.)

- BATTLE MECHANICS:
	- The pendulum swings through the top of each round, starts above Kairos and falls, at the start of the next round it swings back
	- Keep track of Kairos slots
	- While Kairos is down he heals for 30 hp each turn, this goes down by 15 if one of his aspects (Bekarys and Abagnale) die, after both are dead he enters his second phase
	- Kairos splits into 3 beings: Kairos Bekarys and Abagnale
	- Blue Portal: Past
		- ENEMIES: Bekarys
	- Red Portal: Future
		- ENEMIES: Abagnale
